note: A run with NO SPEND CAP, bound by a deadline it finished inside. The only case where cap_micros is -1, and it exists because the README stated that rule with no fixture behind it — a rule the corpus asserts and never exhibits is the kind of requirement a host implements from prose and gets wrong. -1 and NOT 0: zero reads as a cap of nothing, which would make this run — 251 micro-units against a cap of 0 — look like an infinite overspend rather than an unlimited budget. Absence is not zero (§8), at the wire.
